purpose: Fixture-specific, read-only inspection of three native Microsoft Excel derivatives covering seventeen embedded classic chart families, chart caches, error bars, trendlines, secondary axes, 3-D and stock views, native SVG plus raster fallback drawing storage, BIFF12 chart resources, and BIFF8 chart substreams.

provenance.authoring_method: Computer Use / native Microsoft Excel UI
provenance.source: NativeExcelBook7 was authored in Excel with deterministic chart source ranges and one native SVG picture. Seventeen embedded charts were created or changed through the native Insert/Chart UI; the source XLSX was saved as XLSB, closed, and the original XLSX was reopened and saved as legacy XLS.

legacy_xls_warning.observed: Legacy XLS reopening retained the SVG picture as a native raster fallback with alt text; complete chart-family parity is not claimed.

scope_and_limits.chart_title_policy: Native chart titles remained at Excel defaults; worksheet names provide deterministic chart-family identifiers.
scope_and_limits.reader_boundary: Raw package and BIFF inventories establish stored chart and drawing resources. The generic reader examples expose cells/text and bounded chart/drawing package parts; they do not provide an Excel renderer, complete chart-family semantic round-trip, or a native UI equivalence guarantee.

format_boundaries.xlsx: Transitional SpreadsheetML stores all 17 chart XML payloads, 18 drawing parts, explicit caches, and the SVG/raster drawing relationship.
format_boundaries.xlsb: BIFF12 worksheet/workbook/index streams coexist with the same 17 native XML chart payloads and 18 DrawingML parts; chart XML hashes match XLSX.
format_boundaries.xls: BIFF8 stores 18 worksheet BOUNDSHEET entries, 17 nested embedded-chart substreams, and one worksheet without a chart host for the SVG marker; generic litchi-xls reading exposes only the SVG worksheet in this probe.

coverage_rows.xlsb-309: Workbook contains 17 chart resources and 18 worksheet/drawing binary relationships; standalone chart-sheet semantics remain bounded.

validation_methods: SHA-256 and byte sizes were computed from closed final fixture streams.
ZIP central-directory and CRC checks passed for XLSX and XLSB.
All 17 chart XML parts were parsed read-only; each cache had five points and all XLSX/XLSB chart XML hashes matched.

Chart style/color relationships, chart-axis IDs, source formulas, error-bar payloads, trendline flags, bubble-size ranges, stock series, combo axis groups, and SVG/raster drawing relationships were inspected without rewriting bytes.
BIFF12 record inventory was inspected with dump_xlsb_structure and binary_index_profile; no chart part was treated as executable code.
The BIFF8 Workbook stream was inspected with dump_xls_records and inspect_ole; nested chart BOF/EOF framing and chart record families were retained as raw evidence.
Existing litchi-xlsx, litchi-xlsb, litchi-xls and litchi-cfb reader examples were invoked read-only; their projection boundaries are recorded above.
Native Excel close, reopen, warning choice, chart retention, SVG fallback behavior and marker observations are from the root Computer Use session; this inspection did not operate Office UI.
native_ui_observation_source: Root agent Computer Use session; all three final fixtures were saved through native Microsoft Excel, closed, reopened, inspected and closed again without a repair prompt.
